reports.title: SoFi Reports Third Quarter 2026 with Record Net Revenue of $1.4 Billion, Net Income of $241 Million and Raises Full-Year Guidance

guidance.heading: Guidance and Outlook
section: For the full year, management increases its revenue outlook. Management now expects to deliver adjusted net revenue of approximately $5.04 billion which implies approximately 40% annual adjusted net revenue growth year-over-year. Management now expects adjusted EBITDA of approximately $1.66 billion, which equates to an annual adjusted EBITDA margin of approximately 33%. Management also continues to expect adjusted net income of approximately $840 million, which equates to a margin of approximately 17%, and adjusted EPS of approximately 61 cents per share.
For 2026, management continues to expect to increase total members by at least 30% year-over-year.

Based on the broad based momentum in the business, in 2027, management expects to deliver adjusted net revenue of approximately $6.4 billion which implies approximately 27% annual adjusted net revenue growth year-over-year. Management expects adjusted EBITDA of approximately $2.24 billion, which equates to an annual adjusted EBITDA margin of approximately 35%. Management expects adjusted net income of approximately $1.28 billion, reflecting an adjusted net income margin of approximately 20%. Management expects adjusted EPS of approximately 90 cents per share.
